articles.title: Tesla Sales Jumped in First Quarter, Rebounding From Last Year’s Slump
articles.mainIdea: Tesla Sales Jumped in First Quarter, Rebounding From Last Year’s Slump
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Tesla Sales Jumped in First Quarter, Rebounding From Last Year’s Slump. Tesla sales were up 6.3% in the first quarter compared with a year prior, but the company missed Wall Street estimates for deliveries. Related tickers mentioned: F, GM.

articles.title: Tesla Deliveries Grow. Elon Musk's EV Giant Reclaims Sales Crown.
articles.mainIdea: Tesla Deliveries Grow. Elon Musk's EV Giant Reclaims Sales Crown.
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Tesla Deliveries Grow. Elon Musk's EV Giant Reclaims Sales Crown.. Elon Musk's company delivered 408,386 of vehicles in the first quarter. Tesla stock fell ahead of the release but is up for the week. Related tickers mentioned: 002594.SZ.
